description: This file defines the TextMessage class within the WPEFramework::Messaging namespace. The class implements a message containing text data, with methods for serialization and deserialization, and is intended for use in messaging systems.

classes.name: TextMessage
classes.description: A class representing a text message with serialization and deserialization capabilities, implementing the IEvent interface.

methods.name: TextMessage(const string& text)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message with a given text.

methods.name: Serialize(uint8_t buffer[], const uint16_t bufferSize) const
methods.description: Serializes the text message into a buffer, returning the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: Deserialize(const uint8_t buffer[], const uint16_t bufferSize)
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the text message.
